name: BlenderBench
description: Vision-as-inverse-graphics, the concept of reconstructing images into editable programs, remains challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which inherently lack fine-grained spatial grounding in one-shot settings. To address this, we introduce VIGA (Vision-as-Inverse-Graphics Agent), an interleaved multimodal reasoning framework where symbolic logic and visual perception actively cross-verify each other.
